message.reason: Print document skipped: the publication has %1 topic files, above govuk.print.max-topics=%2.
message.response: Raise govuk.print.max-topics, or build print documents per part from submaps. Very large publications are not one printable document.

message.reason: govuk.print.scope=linked would print %1 topic files, above govuk.print.max-topics=%2, so the print document holds the %3 topic files in the navigation only.
message.response: Raise govuk.print.max-topics to print the linked topics as well.

message.reason: Inlined SVG '%1' carries active or remote content (%2): %3.
message.response: Diagrams should be static: no script, foreignObject, event-handler attributes, script-scheme links or references to other origins. govuk.svg.sanitize=yes (the default) removes them; govuk.svg.sanitize=no keeps the file as authored.

message.reason: Inline reference '%1' points outside the input directory: %2.
message.response: The plugin inlines SVG and MathML only from under the input directory (govuk.inline.scope=input). Move the file into the publication, or set govuk.inline.scope=any to inline from anywhere on the build machine.

Script-scheme links, images and objects fetched from another origin, and object embeds are rendered as authored under govuk.content.policy=warn; govuk.content.policy=strip replaces them with a placeholder. govuk.content.warnings=no silences this report.

message.reason: The Content-Security-Policy in force will block %1 '%2' in the browser.
message.response: govuk.csp allows only same-origin resources. Host the resource with the publication, strip it (govuk.content.policy=strip), or set govuk.csp to a policy that permits it.

message.reason: Metadata name '%1' is not a term of a vocabulary the plugin knows, so it was left out wherever it is used (first in %3; %2 in all).
message.response: A data element is metadata when its name is a prefixed term such as dct:spatial. The prefixes are %4; check the prefix and the spelling of the term.

message.reason: %1 pages have no %2, which the %3 metadata table requires (first: %4).
message.response: Give those pages the value it comes from; the manual's metadata topic lists where each value is read.

message.reason: govuk.search.ranking must be 'default', 'reference' or a JSON object of Pagefind ranking options; got '%1'.
message.response: Fix the parameter value. See the manual's search topic for the options.

message.reason: Navigation entry '%1' has keyref='%2' that was not resolved, so it is rendered without a link and without children.
message.response: DITA-OT does not resolve keys inside a map that is itself included with <mapref keyref="...">. Include that submap with <mapref href="..."> instead, or check that the key is defined.

message.reason: The key reference '%1' on the %2 element does not resolve: no key of that name is defined, so the element is %3.
message.response: Check the spelling of the key, and that the map, or a key map it includes, defines it. Text written inside the element is kept as the fallback, so giving the element content leaves the page readable while the key is missing. DITA-OT itself reports this only at its verbose log level, as DOTJ047I.

message.reason: The root map is below the top of its folder tree: %1 of its topic references reach above its folder, the first being '%2'.
message.response: DITA-OT reports DOTJ036W for each, and the stylesheets, scripts and links between pages that this plugin writes are relative to the map's folder, where nothing is. Move the root map to the top of the publication's folder tree, with topics, images, diagrams and key maps beneath it, and include maps kept in subfolders with <mapref href>. Setting args.input.dir widens the plugin's own inline scope (GOVK005W) but not these.

message.reason: The type '%1' declared on '%2' is not one the catalogue record can write, so the entry is left out of it.
message.response: A declared type is a term of a vocabulary the plugin knows (the prefixes are %3), such as dcat:Dataset, dcat:DataService or dct:Standard, or an absolute http(s) or urn address.

message.reason: govuk.dcat=yes, but no entry of the map declares a data asset, so no catalogue record was written.
message.response: Declare an asset with a data element named rdf:type in the topicmeta of the topicref, or submap, that heads it, for example value="dct:Standard". The type is the publisher's statement and is never inferred.

message.reason: The catalogue record for '%1' has no %2, which the %3 table marks as required (data.gov.uk expects it of a record); the record is written without it (%4).
message.response: Give the asset the value it comes from: the entry's title and short description, a licence (govuk.licence.url, or official branding), and an address (govuk.site.url).

message.reason: The glossary has %1 terms, more than the %2 a page's structured data holds, so its DefinedTermSet is left out of the glossary page.
message.response: The glossary itself is unaffected. The page already lists every term; structured data for all of them would roughly double its size. A partial set would be wrong, so none is written.
